title: Rosetta 2
description: Apple’s ahead-of-time + JIT translation running Intel apps on Apple Silicon. Translates x86_64 to aarch64 via AOT + JIT.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Rosetta 1
description: The original PowerPC-to-Intel translator in early OS X. Translates PowerPC to x86 via dynamic translation.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: QEMU user-mode
description: Runs foreign-arch Linux binaries via syscall translation, a dev staple. Translates many to host via dynamic binary translation.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: box86
description: Runs x86 Linux programs on ARM with wrapped native libraries for speed. Translates x86 to ARM 32-bit via dynarec + lib wrapping.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: box64
description: The 64-bit sibling translating x86_64 to AArch64 on Pi and handhelds. Translates x86_64 to aarch64 via dynarec + lib wrapping.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Windows on Arm emulation
description: Windows 11 runs x86/x64 apps on Arm via built-in emulation. Translates x86/x64 to aarch64 via OS-integrated JIT.

title: Intel Houdini
description: Android’s ARM-to-x86 translator letting ARM apps run on x86 Chromebooks. Translates ARM to x86 via dynamic translation.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: ExaGear
description: Eltechs’ x86-on-ARM translator popular on Raspberry Pi before box86. Translates x86 to ARM via dynamic translation.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: DEC FX!32
description: 1990s profiler-guided x86-on-Alpha translation for Windows NT. Translates x86 to Alpha via profiled translation.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Transmeta Code Morphing
description: Crusoe/Efficeon CPUs translated x86 to VLIW in software. Translates x86 to VLIW via software code morphing.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: HP Dynamo
description: The research system that pioneered dynamic optimization of running binaries. Translates PA-RISC/x86 to same (optimized) via dynamic optimization.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: IA-32 Execution Layer
description: Intel’s x86 emulation layer for Itanium Windows/Linux. Translates x86 to IA-64 via OS emulation layer.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: DOSBox dynarec
description: DOSBox’s dynamic core recompiles x86 on the fly for retro gaming. Translates x86 real-mode to host via dynamic recompilation.

title: SheepShaver
description: PowerPC Mac emulator with a JIT for classic Mac OS. Translates PowerPC to host via JIT emulation.

title: PearPC
